pembahasan: Mr. Terry adalah guru baru yang memperkenalkan dirinya kepada seluruh murid kelas di awal semester: "Let me introduce myself. I am Mr. Terry.".

bacaan.teks:
This dialogue is for questions number 16 to 19.

Galang : Good morning, Sir. Excuse me, are you Mr. Rahmat, the new English teacher?
Mr. Rahmat : Good morning. Yes, I am. And what is your name?
Galang : Allow me to introduce myself, Sir. My name is Galang Pratama from Class VII-A. Welcome to SMP Nusantara.
Mr. Rahmat : Thank you, Galang. It’s a pleasure to meet you. By the way, I need to go to the teachers’ office now. See you in class at 9 o’clock.
Galang : It’s a pleasure to meet you too, Sir. Have a nice day!

teks_soal: Why does Galang use the expression "Allow me to introduce myself" instead of "Hi, I’m Galang"?

opsi_jawaban.label: A
opsi_jawaban.teks: Because Mr. Rahmat is his childhood classmate.

opsi_jawaban.label: B
opsi_jawaban.teks: Because he is speaking to a teacher in a formal school situation.

opsi_jawaban.label: C
opsi_jawaban.teks: Because he is angry with Mr. Rahmat.

opsi_jawaban.label: D
opsi_jawaban.teks: Because they are meeting at a birthday party at night.

pembahasan: Galang berbicara kepada guru di sekolah formal, sehingga ungkapan sopan resminya adalah "Allow me to introduce myself, Sir.".

teks_soal:
[Pilihan Ganda Kompleks — Pilih Lebih dari Satu!]
Which statements are TRUE based on the dialogue above? (Choose TWO correct answers)

opsi_jawaban.label: A
opsi_jawaban.teks: The conversation takes place in the morning at school.

opsi_jawaban.label: B
opsi_jawaban.teks: Galang is a seventh-grade student at SMP Nusantara.

opsi_jawaban.label: C
opsi_jawaban.teks: Mr. Rahmat is a new mathematics student in Class VII-A.

opsi_jawaban.label: D
opsi_jawaban.teks: Galang forgets to say a leave-taking expression to Mr. Rahmat.

pembahasan: Pernyataan A benar ("Good morning" di sekolah) dan B benar (Galang murid kelas 7-A). C salah (Mr. Rahmat guru baru). D salah (Galang mengucapkan "Have a nice day!").

bacaan.teks:
This dialogue is for questions number 16 to 19.

Galang : Good morning, Sir. Excuse me, are you Mr. Rahmat, the new English teacher?
Mr. Rahmat : Good morning. Yes, I am. And what is your name?
Galang : Allow me to introduce myself, Sir. My name is Galang Pratama from Class VII-A. Welcome to SMP Nusantara.
Mr. Rahmat : Thank you, Galang. It’s a pleasure to meet you. By the way, I need to go to the teachers’ office now. See you in class at 9 o’clock.
Galang : It’s a pleasure to meet you too, Sir. Have a nice day!

teks_soal: [Tabel Benar / Salah (True or False)] Read the statements based on the dialogue above and give a tick in the True or False column!

pernyataan.teks: "Have a nice day!" is an expression of leave-taking (berpamitan).
Mr. Rahmat is heading to the school library right now.
Galang introduces himself formally using "Allow me to introduce myself, Sir."

pembahasan: (a) True: "Have a nice day!" adalah ungkapan berpamitan. (b) False: Mr. Rahmat menuju ruang guru, bukan perpustakaan. (c) True: perkenalan diri Galang menggunakan ungkapan formal.

teks_soal: Sinta meets her friend Dika at 07.30 p.m. at the bookstore. When they are about to go home and sleep, what leave-taking expression can Sinta say?

pembahasan: Saat berpamitan di malam hari untuk tidur, ungkapan yang tepat adalah "Good night".

pembahasan: Merespons "Nice to meet you", balasan yang tepat adalah "Nice to meet you too".

teks_soal: Which of the following questions is NOT POLITE to ask when introducing yourself to a stranger or an older person in English culture?

opsi_jawaban.label: C
opsi_jawaban.teks: How much is your salary / How much do you weigh?

opsi_jawaban.label: D

pembahasan: Menanyakan gaji (salary) atau berat badan (weight) dianggap tidak sopan dalam budaya Inggris.

teks_soal:

(2) 02.30 p.m.

pembahasan: 08.15 a.m. = Good morning (R); 02.30 p.m. = Good afternoon (P); 07.00 p.m. = Good evening (Q).
